exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb 'to finish'".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb 終わる (〜owaru) matches "Verb 'to finish'".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb 終わる (〜owaru).
exercises.explanation: Expresses that something finishes or an action is completed; a godan verb.
